stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

queries.label: umi-exact-lineage
queries.why: Find the original UMI lineage and papers spelling out the full method name.

queries.label: umi-abbrev-robot-data
queries.why: Catch metadata that uses the UMI acronym without the expanded phrase.

queries.label: umi-named-variants
queries.query: (all:"UMI-3D" OR all:"UMI 3D" OR all:DexUMI OR all:RealDexUMI)
queries.why: Find named variants that expose 3D, dexterity, and wearable-data limitations.

queries.label: umi-force-torque
queries.why: Find UMI extensions for contact-rich or force-aware data collection.

queries.label: umi-handheld-gripper-language
queries.query: (all:"handheld gripper" OR all:"hand-held gripper") AND all:demonstration
queries.why: Catch UMI-like handheld interfaces that may not mention the acronym.

queries.label: umi-usability-limitations
queries.query: all:usability AND all:gripper AND all:"robot learning"
queries.why: Find papers that critique operator burden, gripper design, and data usability.

queries.label: ea-data-robot-demonstrations
queries.why: Find papers that treat demonstrations as reusable robot-learning data.

queries.label: ea-data-demonstration-quality
queries.why: Surface work that audits operator traces, consistency, and usable trajectory quality.

queries.label: ea-data-in-the-wild
queries.why: Capture natural-scene collection papers and their generalization tradeoffs.

queries.label: ea-data-dataset-curation
queries.why: Find dataset organization, filtering, metadata, and quality-control discussions.

queries.label: ea-hardware-teleop-device
queries.query: all:teleoperation AND all:"data collection" AND all:robot
queries.why: Find hardware routes used to collect robot demonstrations.

queries.label: ea-hardware-slam-demonstration
queries.query: all:SLAM AND all:"robot manipulation" AND all:demonstration
queries.why: Capture tracking and reconstruction limitations in collection devices.

queries.label: ea-hardware-arkit-tracking
queries.why: Find low-cost pose-tracking and VIO routes relevant to data capture.

queries.label: ea-hardware-handheld-gripper
queries.query: (all:"handheld gripper" OR all:"hand-held gripper") AND all:robot
queries.why: Catch UMI-like collection devices that may not use UMI in metadata.

browser_fallback_queries.label: browser-umi-named-lineage
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs ("Universal Manipulation Interface" OR "UMI-FT" OR "UMI-3D" OR DexUMI OR RealDexUMI) robot manipulation
browser_fallback_queries.why: Find UMI lineage and named variants through arXiv pages when API metadata search misses exact names.

browser_fallback_queries.label: browser-umi-usability-quality
browser_fallback_queries.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (UMI OR "handheld gripper" OR "hand-held gripper") ("demonstration quality" OR usability OR ergonomics) "robot learning"
browser_fallback_queries.why: Find negative or conditional UMI data-usability discussions around gripper design and operator burden.

browser_fallback_queries.label: browser-umi-sensing-transfer-limits

browser_fallback_queries.why: Find UMI-adjacent limitation papers about sensing, tracking, force, tactile feedback, or embodiment transfer.
